Specification: This specification models a very small two-variable transition system used as a deadlock-oriented test. The state consists of a natural-valued counter x and a Boolean flag y, initialized to 0 and FALSE respectively. The only transition increments x while x <= 3 and flips y on every step, and the temporal specification requires the behavior to start in Init and then always evolve according to [][Next]_<<x, y>>.
